answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via clock skew fingerprinting. Nodes anchor identities to the unique hardware frequency drift of an onboard quartz crystal oscillator, verified through a low-overhead peer whisper protocol. An adversary incurs substantial hardware and power costs to operate dedicated physical oscillators for every identity instead of multiplexing virtual nodes. However, ambient temperature shifts alter clock frequency, leading to false rejections of honest agents.
